name: Gnosis Pay
rootCause: Gnosis Pay disclosed a bug in its Delay Module that was being actively exploited. The Delay Module provides a security timelock for transactions in Gnosis Pay’s self-custodial card system. Users were urgently advised to withdraw their EURe and GNO balances immediately. The Gnosis team confirmed that affected users will be fully reimbursed.

descriptions.text: Gnosis Pay disclosed a bug in its Delay Module that was being actively exploited. The Delay Module provides a security timelock for transactions in Gnosis Pay’s self-custodial card system. Users were urgently advised to withdraw their EURe and GNO balances immediately. The Gnosis team confirmed that affected users will be fully reimbursed.

On 1 June 2026, a critical logic flaw in the Zodiac Delay Module used by Gnosis Pay wallets on Gnosis Chain allowed attackers to bypass EIP-1271 signature verification, enabling unauthorized withdrawals. Approximately $1.5 million was drained from user accounts, with additional funds locked. Gnosis responded by restoring balances, patching the vulnerability, and expanding security measures. The deployed Delay Module (Zodiac v3.4.0) failed to check whether ERC-1271 signature verification calls succeeded, trusting the return value from isValidSignature even when the call reverted. This enabled attacker contracts to forge valid approvals.
